items.title: Palantir and Microsoft Drop. Why the AI Revival Is Hitting Software Stocks.
items.summary: Palantir slid 2.2% and Microsoft dipped 2.3%.  Salesforce ServiceNow  and  Workday  were among the other software stocks trading in the red.
